nl: Run only the tests in tests/test_text.py (8 test methods) and report how many of them pass.
oracle_program: test.run "." framework: unittest targets: ["tests.test_text"] |> filter status == "passed" |> count
reference_pwsh:
$py = if ($IsWindows) { 'python' } else { 'python3' }
(& $py -m unittest tests.test_text -v 2>&1 | ForEach-Object { "$_" } | Select-String '\.\.\. ok$').Count
